about: Registry of narration voices for render.py. Every voice here runs locally on CPU and was rendered and measured on 2026-11-16. Licences: LICENSES.md. Rejected voices are listed there, not here.

speed_keys.steady / slow / brisk: Engine speed render.py starts from for that pace (1.0 is the engine's own rate). It then measures each clip and re-reads it until the pace is met.
speed_keys.min: Lowest engine speed allowed for lines of 4 words or more. Set from calibrate.py: below it the speech-to-text round trip gets worse for this voice.
speed_keys.min_short: The same for clips of 1 to 3 words, which degrade sooner. These clips are read once at max(pace speed, min_short), never above 1.0.
speed_keys.clip_overrides: Optional, per voice: {clip id: {min: speed, why: text}}. Raises the speed floor for one clip that failed its round trip at the usual floor. Only that clip is re-rendered.

c1-C-1-2.why: At engine speed 0.72 both recognisers heard an extra first word ("Be mud in the walls", "A mud in the walls"). With the floor at 0.90 the clip was 12.6% over its pace (its round trip was not tested). At 0.85 both recognisers hear it word for word and it is 10.5% over. Checked 2026-11-16.

melo-india.accent: Indian English. The speaker is part of the published model, not an accent put on by this pipeline.

piper-ljspeech.accent: American English (neutral). Female. Trained from scratch on the public domain LJ Speech dataset.
piper-ljspeech.licence: Voice: public domain dataset, model repository MIT. Engine: piper-tts GPL-3.0-or-later (used as a local tool, not shipped).
